title: (RHBA-2018:3546) Red Hat Ansible Runner 1.1.2 Release
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Ansible Runner|Red Hat Ansible Runner|1.1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
A new Ansible Runner package is available with the following changes:

- Fixed an issue where the ssh sock path could be too long
- Fixed an issue passing extra vars as dictionaries via the interface
- Fixed an issue where stdout was delayed on buffering, which also caused
  stdout to not be available if the task was canceled or failed
- Fixed role-path parameter not being honored when given on the command 
  line; also fixed unit tests to surface this error if it comes back
- Added a fully on-board Zuul-CI for unit and integration testing
